freshSelectionGuards: Run only in the newly created candidate. Confirm .env, .env.local and .convex/local/default are absent before FIRST bootstrap; no existing state may be renamed, deleted, copied or reused to satisfy this condition.

Also require absence of the resolved legacy ~/.convex/anonymous-convex-backend-state/anonymous-agent directory. Agent mode uses the fixed anonymous-agent name; the storage resolver can reuse a matching legacy directory even after the chooser calls it new.

Use a subprocess-local environment that removes CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY, CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN, CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT, CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL, CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_KEY, CONVEX_PROVISION_HOST and stale frontend binding variables without printing their values. Set CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous. Require CONVEX_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS not false. Do not mutate the parent shell/global configuration or copy provider keys.

Do not pass --configure, --local, --cloud, --prod, --deployment, --deployment-name, --team, --project, --dev-deployment, --url, --admin-key or an existing --env-file. The configured environment wins before anonymous fallback; --configure bypasses normal selection.

Select two different free valid ports explicitly. --local-cloud-port and --local-site-port are installed supported hidden options; requested-port conflict fails rather than silently changing that requested port. Reserve proof ownership and verify actual PID/listener addresses after start because port discovery has an ordinary time-of-check gap.

Keep raw bootstrap output private. The installed verbose native-launch command contains its generated instance secret; do not enable or publish verbose logs. New credentials/state belong only to the isolated local deployment.

supportedCommands.purpose: Start empty backend with explicit ports before source push; supervise as a persistent owned process
supportedCommands.notes: Omit --once: skip-push bypasses the routine that normally flushes/exits; adding --once does not establish one-shot lifetime. No --typecheck disable or codegen override. CLI initialization can still create/update generated setup/AI guidance files; capture exact before/after tracked input hashes.

supportedCommands.purpose: After actual loopback-only owned listeners verified, stop that bootstrap with supported SIGINT and verify only its child exits; then normal source push/watch
supportedCommands.notes: Same candidate and sanitized child environment. Only the freshly generated local selection/config may now be present. Keep normal typecheck and codegen behavior.

supportedCommands.purpose: Set the one public-creation admission flag on this fresh anonymous backend
supportedCommands.notes: Same candidate and sanitized selection environment, after verifying generated target is the anonymous local deployment. With an owned backend already running this reuses it; otherwise env set starts and stops an ephemeral saved local backend in finally. Never use env list or read keys.

loopbackGap: Installed CLI returns http://127.0.0.1:<port> but runLocalBackend passes no bind/listen-host argument to the native binary. Neither its default listening interfaces nor loopback-only binding is proven by this source inspection. Inspect both owned native listeners before any source push/admission; if any wildcard/LAN binding is seen, stop only owned child and inspect supported native help/options. No unverified bind flag is invented.

lifetime.init: convex init explicitly flushes/exits with cleanup and no push, but exposes no port options.
lifetime.normalOnce: convex dev --once performs normal push and reaches devAgainstDeployment flushAndExit, which invokes registered child cleanup.
lifetime.skipPush: skip-push omits devAgainstDeployment; its spawned child remains referenced. Treat as supervised persistent bootstrap, irrespective of --once.
lifetime.cleanup: SIGINT handler calls flushAndExit; registered native cleanup issues p.kill(SIGTERM) to the child object. It does not await child exit or prove both sockets are released. Windows force-terminating a parent is not equivalent to a graceful SIGINT proof. Retain owned PID handles and verify actual exit/ports; do not terminate unrelated processes.

backendGuards.creation: NODESLIDE_PUBLIC_CREATION=true admits the documented public-launch subject instead of preview-code admission. It does not choose a model; explicit deterministic selection is still required.
crons: 2-minute stale-run recovery fails abandoned local runs; it does not restart a provider.
Three hourly prune jobs remove expired local trace/comparison/evidence records.

15-minute opted-in source scan only claims enabled due schedules, bounded by DUE_BATCH and daily caps; refresh action requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY before fetching. A fresh empty DB with no imported schedules has no due source work.
30-minute retention removes only marked expired production-probe workspaces.
backendGuards.limit: Fresh local state and no source subscriptions/uploads/provider keys are necessary assumptions. This inspection does not certify every backend function or a future populated database.

npmCheckNativeOffice.evidence: Vite config excludes tests/e2e; workspace test scripts invoke Vitest. The PPTX static-intent subprocess runs the JSZip/OOXML structural canary, whose source explicitly distinguishes the separate native PowerPoint motion canary. The retained trace test reads .tmp traces via find; scratch gate tests spawn Node. No native Excel/PowerPoint executable/COM dispatch was found in these inspected check owners.
npmCheckNativeOffice.limit: Static review only; no additional test execution or universal transitive dependency no-side-effect guarantee. Root owns the already running unchanged npm check.
npmCheckNativeOffice.scanMatchInterpretation: The four keyword matches are comments/test-description references to LibreOffice; none is native process dispatch.

generatedSelectionRequirement: Successful bootstrap writes its generated anonymous CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT and frontend/backend URLs through configure.ts before return, even with skip-push. Keep that newly generated candidate selection for subsequent env set. loadSelectedDeploymentCredentials refuses anonymous selection with deploymentName null; anonymous mode alone is insufficient for env set. Confirm the new selection describes only this owned anonymous deployment, without publishing config or credential values.
